matla: یارکب یا مترحلین مراقیل // من قطع منجوب الفدافد عجاف
text: یارکب یا مترحلین مراقیل // من قطع منجوب الفدافد عجاف

matla: ياراكب من فوق مثل السبرتات // حمرا فتاة من لقاح معفاة
text: ياراكب من فوق مثل السبرتات // حمرا فتاة من لقاح معفاة

matla: ليلة لفانا السيل يازيد وافيت // موضى الجبين وسيد تلعات الاعناق
text: ليلة لفانا السيل يازيد وافيت // موضى الجبين وسيد تلعات الاعناق

matla: كل قضى شفه ومن خلته نال // حلو وانا ما دمت فی طلب دیني
text: كل قضى شفه ومن خلته نال // حلو وانا ما دمت فی طلب دیني

matla: الصدر ضاق وباح مني زفيره // والقلب يشعل واهج به تقل نار
text: الصدر ضاق وباح مني زفيره // والقلب يشعل واهج به تقل نار

matla: قال من جفنه جفا طيب المنام // من هوا طفل سلب عقلي وراح
text: قال من جفنه جفا طيب المنام // من هوا طفل سلب عقلي وراح

matla: البارحه ظلن عيوني سهارا // والدمع من عينى على الخد منثور
text: البارحه ظلن عيوني سهارا // والدمع من عينى على الخد منثور

matla: من هلت قصير الين جاني اتلاه // لا عاد واجهته ولا زاد جاني
text: من هلت قصير الين جاني اتلاه // لا عاد واجهته ولا زاد جاني

matla: يافهيد واثر دیار الاجناب ملهاه // مقدار حد ومن تذکر یروحي
text: يافهيد واثر دیار الاجناب ملهاه // مقدار حد ومن تذکر یروحي

matla: خلافذا یاراکب صیعریات // من ساس عیرات عراب تلاد
text: خلافذا یاراکب صیعریات // من ساس عیرات عراب تلاد

matla: ما لون يانفس عن الزاد معطاه // والماي ما يبرد لهبها بروده
text: ما لون يانفس عن الزاد معطاه // والماي ما يبرد لهبها بروده

matla: یاحیف یارجل بثوبه قیاطین // علی غلام ليت ما هوب ثوبه
text: یاحیف یارجل بثوبه قیاطین // علی غلام ليت ما هوب ثوبه

matla: يا الله تجعل كل دربي سماح // بهداك تامرني على اللي به اصلاح
text: يا الله تجعل كل دربي سماح // بهداك تامرني على اللي به اصلاح

matla: ياتل قلبي تل رکب لشرشوح // رکب علی تالي الدبش خاطفینه
text: ياتل قلبي تل رکب لشرشوح // رکب علی تالي الدبش خاطفینه

matla: یاتل قلبی تل ركب لشمشول // ربع مشاکیل علی کنس حيل
text: یاتل قلبی تل ركب لشمشول // ربع مشاکیل علی کنس حيل

matla: أسباب ما فاجى الحشا وابتلاني // غرو صفى بالغي صرف لسانه
text: أسباب ما فاجى الحشا وابتلاني // غرو صفى بالغي صرف لسانه

matla: يا الله ياللي ما لغيره ترجيت // ياواحد ما غيره احد رجيته
text: يا الله ياللي ما لغيره ترجيت // ياواحد ما غيره احد رجيته

matla: يا اهل الهوى خلوه خلوه خلوه // لا عاد تطرونه سمج لا تبونه
text: يا اهل الهوى خلوه خلوه خلوه // لا عاد تطرونه سمج لا تبونه

matla: عيني لها هويات ما طاوعتني // تولعت في حب حي محنها
text: عيني لها هويات ما طاوعتني // تولعت في حب حي محنها

matla: الله من عين تهله عباري // تشدي لهملول السحاب اندفاقه
text: الله من عين تهله عباري // تشدي لهملول السحاب اندفاقه

matla: ياذعار انا قلبي من العام حوله // جسمي نحل ما باقي الا قليله
text: ياذعار انا قلبي من العام حوله // جسمي نحل ما باقي الا قليله

matla: والله لولا الهرج ندرا قوافيه//ومن حاسد يركب علينا حصانه
text: والله لولا الهرج ندرا قوافيه//ومن حاسد يركب علينا حصانه

matla: يامل قلب من شديد العرب باه // بوهة غرير بالمظامي رمت به
text: يامل قلب من شديد العرب باه // بوهة غرير بالمظامي رمت به

matla: يا الله ياعالم خفيات الاسرار // ياعالم ما يطرق المودمان
text: يا الله ياعالم خفيات الاسرار // ياعالم ما يطرق المودمان

matla: نطیت مرقاب براسه رجوم // مرقاب طراد الهوی ویل من جاه
text: نطیت مرقاب براسه رجوم // مرقاب طراد الهوی ویل من جاه

matla: لولاي اوسع خاطري بالتنهات // وافکر بحالي من خلاي بخلایه
text: لولاي اوسع خاطري بالتنهات // وافکر بحالي من خلاي بخلایه

matla: اعوي عوى ذيب بليل عوى به // خطر عليه تلافة النفس بعواه
text: اعوي عوى ذيب بليل عوى به // خطر عليه تلافة النفس بعواه

matla: ياهن مما ينعش الروح شف لي//ما دمت انا واياك والنفس حيه
text: ياهن مما ينعش الروح شف لي//ما دمت انا واياك والنفس حيه

matla: يا الله ياللي تسجد الخلق لرضاه // ياوامر خلقه على حج بيته
text: يا الله ياللي تسجد الخلق لرضاه // ياوامر خلقه على حج بيته

matla: يامل عين حاربت لذة النوم // كن الاداوي بالنضير محذوفه
text: يامل عين حاربت لذة النوم // كن الاداوي بالنضير محذوفه

matla: حمام على روس المراقيب غنا // رفجاني ودمع المقلتين نثير
text: حمام على روس المراقيب غنا // رفجاني ودمع المقلتين نثير

matla: آه واعزاه من مثلي دهاه // عن حلى نوم الملا هم ثقيل
text: آه واعزاه من مثلي دهاه // عن حلى نوم الملا هم ثقيل

matla: مرحبا ما روجع القمري غناه // واعتلى بالصوت في دوح ظليل
text: مرحبا ما روجع القمري غناه // واعتلى بالصوت في دوح ظليل

matla: سر ياقلم من بين مفروض الاصباع // بالزاج شرع واضح الطلح تشريع
text: سر ياقلم من بين مفروض الاصباع // بالزاج شرع واضح الطلح تشريع

matla: سلامي على اللي من التغراب وافاني // على غفلة جاني من البعد لي عانى ٣٧/١٩٣
text: سلامي على اللي من التغراب وافاني // على غفلة جاني من البعد لي عانى ٣٧/١٩٣

matla: يقول الزناتي والزناتي خليفه // نفس الفتى لا بدها من زوالها

matla: يازید تنساني وتنسى جمایلي // وتنسى جميلي ياجحود الجمايل
text: يازید تنساني وتنسى جمایلي // وتنسى جميلي ياجحود الجمايل

matla: يقول ابن قريع. . .  // كما الدراهم بايد من عد ونقدا

matla: زعجت له صوت وانا بالدفينه//صوت ولا ظنيت توحى باذانه
text: زعجت له صوت وانا بالدفينه//صوت ولا ظنيت توحى باذانه

matla: يازايري في عمان قبل ينجالي // جنح الدجا والملا بالنوم ذهالي
text: يازايري في عمان قبل ينجالي // جنح الدجا والملا بالنوم ذهالي

matla: قم سو ما يجمد على الصين ياذياب // بدلال بيض كالبطاط المحاديب
text: قم سو ما يجمد على الصين ياذياب // بدلال بيض كالبطاط المحاديب

matla: تعززوا للي برى حاله الدوب // دوب الفراق وحرق الدمع خديه
text: تعززوا للي برى حاله الدوب // دوب الفراق وحرق الدمع خديه

matla: ادرت فکري بامر دنیاي لی ادبرت // وطاوعتها واتبعت نفسي عسورها
text: ادرت فکري بامر دنیاي لی ادبرت // وطاوعتها واتبعت نفسي عسورها

matla: لی افكرت بالدنیا تبذك ثلومه // لازم تشوف من القدر کوس واشغال
text: لی افكرت بالدنیا تبذك ثلومه // لازم تشوف من القدر کوس واشغال

matla: الله من عين تهل الدموع // وقلب تشعب بين لاوي وجرار
text: الله من عين تهل الدموع // وقلب تشعب بين لاوي وجرار

matla: قال الذي يبدي من الراس مكنون // كلام احلى من شخاليل طاوي
text: قال الذي يبدي من الراس مكنون // كلام احلى من شخاليل طاوي

matla: البارحه ياشعيل ياحيل ابا الحيل // العين عن نوم المخاليق فره
text: البارحه ياشعيل ياحيل ابا الحيل // العين عن نوم المخاليق فره

matla: یامل قلب به هوالیس وهموم // هم دخل بالقلب من کثر ما ريت
text: یامل قلب به هوالیس وهموم // هم دخل بالقلب من کثر ما ريت

matla: خلوني ادوج دام بیه تدواج // ولیا عجزت اقعد مقادیر ساعه
text: خلوني ادوج دام بیه تدواج // ولیا عجزت اقعد مقادیر ساعه

matla: خلوني انهت دام بيه تنهات // اما سلمت وطبت والا كتلتني
text: خلوني انهت دام بيه تنهات // اما سلمت وطبت والا كتلتني

matla: سيرت انا يالشيخ يمك وناصيك // وعودت في كبدي سواة المليله
text: سيرت انا يالشيخ يمك وناصيك // وعودت في كبدي سواة المليله

matla: نطيت روس مشمرخات العراقيب // راس الطويل النايف المقلحز
text: نطيت روس مشمرخات العراقيب // راس الطويل النايف المقلحز

matla: سبك لك نجوم الدهر بالفكر حاذق//حوى واحتوى مضمونها بامر خالق ۲٠۸/٥٣
text: سبك لك نجوم الدهر بالفكر حاذق//حوى واحتوى مضمونها بامر خالق ۲٠۸/٥٣

matla: قل عنك ما الدنيا بيلحق لها تالي // غيور ترد الحزب الاول على التالي
text: قل عنك ما الدنيا بيلحق لها تالي // غيور ترد الحزب الاول على التالي

text: الى ابصرت بالدنيا تكدر لي الصافي // تعذر زماني ما حصل صاحب صافي ۲۱١/٤٥

matla: ليا ابصرت بالدنيا وهيض همومي // ما حام في ليحان صدري وحام
text: ليا ابصرت بالدنيا وهيض همومي // ما حام في ليحان صدري وحام

matla: تربح بها نفس وروح شقیه//وقبل بمیدان الهوی یهجل اهجال
text: تربح بها نفس وروح شقیه//وقبل بمیدان الهوی یهجل اهجال

matla: هيه ياركب على كور النجاب//مدنيات البيد مطلوب الغريب
text: هيه ياركب على كور النجاب//مدنيات البيد مطلوب الغريب

poem_matla: يا مدوّر الهين ترى الكايد أحلى، اسأل مغني كايدات الطروقي
title: يا مدوّر الهين
translation_en: O you who seeks the easy path, know that the difficult is sweeter, ask the singer of difficult melodies | Beauty is expensive, but the more beautiful is more expensive, and every buyer has their merchandise and market | The star is high, and the sky above it is higher, whoever surpasses knowledge, another knowledge surpasses me | Welcome difficulty! I said: O difficulty, be easy! Since you want me, you difficulty are my longing | I love to break the mare that acts precious, and I love to tame every wild horse that bolts | I love to travel with clouds that rise high, and I love the lightning's flash above the clouds | I love to stay awake with the full moon that reveals itself, and draw the sun's rays at sunrise | O you who took charge of my rebellious heart, remain compassionate to the heart of dignity | Honor the dear one who never humbled himself in life, who drives his life toward noble deeds | I chose you from all people, a companion for the heart, for you are my desire, my way, and my taste | I wouldn't search for every adorned person, if not for you being worthy, I wouldn't have given you my heartbeat | The difficult one has arrived/appeared | I said oh difficult one, welcome | As long as you want me? | For you are, oh difficult one, my longing | I love to tame the filly that plays hard to get | I love to tame the filly that plays hard to get | And I love to tame every eye that glances at me | And I love to travel with clouds that rise high | And I love above the clouds the flash of lightning | And I love to stay awake with my full moon that has appeared | And I draw the sun's rays at sunrise | O you who has taken control over my rebellious heart | O you who has taken control over my rebellious heart | Keep yourself on the heart of dignity with compassion | Honor the dear one in life | He doesn't seek guidance, driving his life aimlessly | O you who has taken control over my rebellious heart | Keep yourself on the heart of dignity with compassion | Honor the dear one who in life never sought guidance | He drives his life to the precipices as I drive mine | I chose you from among all people | I chose you from among all people | For the heart, leave it be | Oh wherever you are, you are my desire, my mood, and my taste | I didn't go searching for every adorned person, without you they're worthless | I didn't give you my heart

matla: بشاير
text:
بشاير
أشواقي ما فتّحت
أشواقي ما بانت
وأشواقي ما عمرها قالت
ولا باحت
أحزاني عشب البحر
وهمومي عطر الليل
دانة حنيني بصدف
ما صادها في بحر العشق غواص
وطيوري في أشجار السحب
ما راعها حابل ولا قناص
زروعي ما تنوصف
وأنهاري ما تنعد
أحلامي بوسع الفضاء
وقلبي عشق ينزف
مذبوح أرقص من ألم
بين الجزر والمدّ
هيمان يا لحظة فرح
عاشق بليا حد
خذ يا بنفسج وله
خذني إلى بابك
خذني ندامى ليلتك
أعشق بشاير طلتك
وأعطّر ترابك
وأقول تالي العمر
زهّر علي الورد
poem_matla: بشاير
title: بشاير
translation_en: Good tidings | My longings have not bloomed / My longings have not appeared | And my longings have never spoken / Nor revealed | My sorrows are seaweed / And my worries are the night's perfume | The pearl of my longing in a shell / No diver has caught it in love's sea | And my birds in the cloud trees / No trapper or hunter has frightened them | My crops cannot be described / And my rivers cannot be counted | My dreams are as vast as space / And my heart is bleeding love | Slaughtered, I dance from pain / Between the ebb and tide | Lovestruck, oh moment of joy / A lover without limits | Take, oh violet of passion / Take me to your door | Take me as companion of your night / I love the good tidings of your appearance | And I perfume your soil / And say for the rest of life / May roses bloom upon me | My dreams are as vast as space | And my heart bleeds with love | Slaughtered, I dance from pain | Between the ebb and the tide | Enamored, oh moment of joy | A lover without limits | Take, oh violet, its passion | Take me to your door | Take me as your companion for your night | I adore the good tidings of your appearance | And I perfume your soil | And I say at the end of life | The roses bloomed for me

matla: يوم هب الشرقي وطابي
text:
يوم هب الشرقي وطابي
اللي به قلوب الملا تطيبي
ذكرني وهيّض مما بي
وهلّت دموعي سواكيب
چيبي، على وليفٍ صدّ واقفى بي
من عقب ماهو يثنّي بي
وش بدا من سوء الالقافي
شمت حسود المراقيب
نفّذ لي حكم الغيابي
ولا يحكم الشرع على الغيبي
قالوا وش بك ما تعطي نابي دائما مهوجس
ولا تجيبي
قلت انا مالي بالعتابي
ولا اتبع درب المعاتيبي
آخذ الطيب بالأطيابي
ولا اسخي به لين يسخي بي
وأركض ركابي بمسحابي
هب في كل المساحيبي
آخذ الطيب بالأطيابي
ولا اسخي به لين يسخي بي
وأركض ركابي بمسحابي
هب في كل المساحيبي
تاق قلبي توق العقابي صوبكم واشواقي سغيبي، قمت أونّ بكل مرقاب
وأتلي روس الرواقيبي
واللي يشوف الحال من ذاب
قال وش بك من التصاويب
سر وشوف علاج وأسبابي
للطبيب وكل حسّيبي
قال لي كشّاف الكتابي
يافلان نجومك تغيبي
قلت خلوا خلّي أولى بي
چيف ما يبغي يسوي بي
هو عيوني النعس وأهدابي
وجيد يزغى نزغة الهيفي
وان رمس بالهرج نصابي
ما يكثر من التهذريبي
عود موز وفيغة الرابي
فرق عن حر اللواهيبي
يعل لي بفراقه سعى بي
وسط يوفه قرحة التيبي
على النبي صلوا والأصحابي
وذكروا الله عالم الغيبي
poem_matla: يوم هب الشرقي وطابي
title: يوم هب الشرقي وطابي
translation_en: When the eastern wind blew and pleased me / That which makes the hearts of people content | It reminded me and stirred what's within me / And my tears flowed in streams | For a beloved who turned away and stood against me / After he used to lean towards me | What appeared from the evil of encounters / The envious watchers gloated over him | He executed judgment in my absence / And law doesn't judge the absent | They said what's wrong with you, not responding, always anxious / And you don't answer | I said I have no interest in reproach / Nor do I follow the path of those who blame | I take kindness with kindness / And I don't give generously until he's generous with me | And I run my mount in my withdrawal / Blowing through all the expanses | I take kindness with kindness / And I don't give generously until he's generous with me | And I run my mount in my withdrawal / Blowing through all the expanses | My heart yearned like an eagle's yearning towards you, my longings intense / I began moaning at every watchtower and reciting at the hilltops | And whoever sees the state of one who melted / Says what's wrong with you from the afflictions | Go and seek treatment and causes / To the doctor and every accountant | The fortune-teller told me / O so-and-so, your stars are setting | I said leave my beloved to me / However he wants to treat me | He is my eyes' sleep and my eyelashes / And a neck that sways like a willow | And when he speaks eloquently / He doesn't indulge in idle talk | A banana stalk and the hill's fig / Different from the heat of flames | May his separation cause me striving / In the midst of standing, the wound of drying | And I run my camels with my racing camel | It blew through all my expanses | My heart yearned for you like an eagle yearns, and my longings are my torment, I stood moaning at every watchtower | And I recite to the heads of the watchmen | And whoever sees the state of one who has melted away | He said what's wrong with you from the afflictions | Go and see my remedy and my reasons | To the doctor and all my relatives | The fortune teller told me | Oh so-and-so, your stars are setting | I said leave him, my friend is more worthy of me | How does he not want to do anything with me | He is the drowsiness of my eyes and my eyelashes | And a beautiful neck that sways with the graceful movement of the slender one | And if he speaks with idle talk, it afflicts me | He doesn't talk nonsense much | A banana stalk and the spring fig | Different from the scorching heat of the burning flames | Perhaps he sought through his separation to afflict me | In the midst of his standing, the wound of my misfortune | Pray upon the Prophet and my companions | And they remembered Allah, the Knower of the unseen

matla: المناعير انك بطول الهم
text:
المناعير انك بطول الهم
لا تبتليها
ويا الله لا تخلي بيوت المسافير
ارب لي ضاق السنافي يجيها
تشعفني الغيمة
ويشجنني الطير
والأرض ما كن ودي امشي عليها
وفي عيني الدنيا
قليل من كثير
جرادة من صادها
يشتويها وللناس وجهتهم
وانا وجهتي غير
ولكل حيّ هواية يهتويها
والأيام
ممزوج صفاها بتكدير
والله كريم ورحمته نرتجيها
وأنا صبور وقانعٍ بالمقادير
ومتوقعٍ ساعة فرج واحتريها
ورزقي على الله
يوم بعض المدابير
كرامته حفنة ورق تشتريها
حلفت؟ ما رد، والخلايق مصادير
ولو لقمتي بتذلني ما اشتهيها
ناس على ما بهش مثل العصافير
وناسٍ عطاها الله وجعل يهنيها
لكن من التجار كم من عثيبير
قد غسّلت منه المروءة يديها
وكم من فقير مدهل للمسايير
عز القصيد ولابته بيحميها
أكنّ للطيب معزة وتقدير
وأذكر هل الطولات وأشير إليها
وقالوا تحذى الخيل من جبهة العير
أمدح بها ناسٍ وناس اهجيها
يا صاحبي جار الدهر والله مجير
ومنك تبلغ خطوة بيخطيها
لي جشّني لي مما يحبه تقاصير
حاول ينزل هامته ويحميها
وحاول يدور للقصور أي تبرير
وما دامها حوله يبا يحتويها
تقدر تقول أزمة وعدت على خير
وخرجت من دوامة كنت فيها
وتقدر تقول أنها زوابع وأعاصير
وقفت وأعلنت انتصاري عليها
poem_matla: المناعير انك بطول الهم
title: يا الله لي ضاقت صدور المناعير
translation_en: O Allah, when the chests of the afflicted are constricted by prolonged grief, do not test them further | O Allah, do not leave the homes of travelers empty when the master who narrowed the paths comes to them | The clouds torment me and the birds sadden me, and I don't wish to walk upon this earth | In my eyes, the world is little from much, like a locust that whoever catches it roasts it | People have their direction and I have mine different, and every living being has a passion they pursue | Days are mixed, their clarity with turbidity, and Allah is generous and we hope for His mercy | I am patient and content with fate, expecting an hour of relief that I await | My sustenance is from Allah, when some arrangements honor is just a handful of papers you buy | I swore not to return, people are destined, and if my morsel humiliates me I don't desire it | Some people are like sparrows over what they have, and some Allah gave and made it pleasant for them | But among merchants how many are corrupt, chivalry has washed its hands of them | And how many poor ones guide the travelers, poetry's glory and its people protect it | I hold affection and appreciation for the good, and remember those of noble deeds and point to them | They say horses imitate the donkey's forehead, I praise some people with it and satirize others | O my friend, time has turned and Allah is the protector, from you a step reaches what it steps | Whoever has shortcomings from what he loves, tries to lower his head and protect it | And tries to find any justification for shortcomings, and as long as they're around him he wants to contain them | You can say it's a crisis that passed well, and I emerged from a whirlpool I was in | And you can say they were storms and hurricanes, I stood and declared my victory over them | When some plans/arrangements | His dignity is a handful of papers you can buy | I swore? He didn't respond, and people are sources/witnesses | And if your morsel would humiliate me, I don't desire it | People are carefree like birds | And people whom God gave to and made them blessed | But among the merchants, how many are deceitful | Chivalry has washed its hands of him | How many poor people astonish the wealthy | The glory of poetry, and no one can protect it | I hold deep affection and appreciation for goodness | And I remember those with tall stature and point to them | And they said horses take warning from the donkey's forehead | With it I praise some people and satirize others | O my friend, time has been unjust, but God is the protector | And from you, a step reaches whoever takes it | When he prepared for me what he loves, shortcomings appeared | He tries to lower his head and protect it | And he tries to find any justification for the shortcomings | As long as she is around him, he wants to embrace her | You can say the crisis has passed peacefully | And I emerged from a whirlpool I was in | And you can say that they are storms and hurricanes | I stood and declared my victory over her

matla: الجادل اللي يمر القلب شارعها بين الحنايا تعدى ما تطالعني تقفي مع الدم بعروقي وأتابعها وأحس كنها على نفسي توزعني
text:
الجادل اللي يمر القلب شارعها بين الحنايا تعدى ما تطالعني تقفي مع الدم بعروقي وأتابعها وأحس كنها على نفسي توزعني
قامت تبعثر غلا وان جيت اجمعها أضمها واتشتت لين تجمعني بين الحنايا تثنى في مرابعها كنها تقول اتحدى
من يطلّعني، دام الحشا بيتها
وانا مدلعها، وش دخل القلب يزعل
يوم توجعني، وليا خذا رمشها
رجل يطالعها لعل رمشٍ خذاني
ما يرجعني، عيونها جيوش
والنظرة طلايعها غارت بصدري وجاد بسيفها
طعني ويوم انكفت
لين قلبي من قلايعها والصبر عن خافقي ماعاد
ينفعني، مدهالها القلب
وعيوني مراتعها، أموت فيها وهي للريح
تزرعني، لو تدري الريح عن هادي طبايعها ما هزت غصون قلبي لين ودعني، ريحانتي
والغلا في القلب زارعها، تشرب عروقي وترواني وتشبعني كن النحل من رحيق الورد
مشبعها، وانا شموخي من أحلى شي جوّعني وليا تعانق خجلها
مع تواضعها عانقت ليلٍ على مسراه شجعني لو ينسرى ليلها
سريت بايعها، بشر ولا الله عن الزلة مرفعني، واصبحت من عقب ما اني ضدها معها ان ضاعت أضيع
وان دلّت تسنعني وان شفت بالعين قلبي بين أصابعها سجدت لله يا الله لا تضيعني، وان جات للجد
واسقتني مدامعها علمتها الدمع للعشاق وش يعني الدمع
صوتٍ ليا غازل مسامعها تشوف صوتي واذا مريت تسمعني والله ما كنت أطاوعها ولا أسمعها لكنه الحب سمّعني وطوّعني للجادل الي شراييني شوارعها القلب يقتادني والسلم يمنعني
poem_matla: الجادل اللي يمر القلب شارعها بين الحنايا تعدى ما تطالعني تقفي مع الدم بعروقي وأتابعها وأحس كنها على نفسي توزعني
title: الجادل اللي يمر القلب شارعها
translation_en: The beautiful one whose streets my heart passes through, between the ribs she crosses without looking at me, she stops with the blood in my veins and I follow her, and I feel as if she distributes me upon myself | She began scattering precious love and when I try to gather it, I embrace it and scatter until she gathers me, between the ribs she bends in her territories, as if she says 'I challenge whoever can make me leave' | As long as my chest is her home and I pamper her, what business does the heart have being upset when it hurts me | When her eyelash takes a man who looks at her, perhaps an eyelash has taken me and won't return me | Her eyes are armies and their forward scouts raided my chest and struck generously with her sword, stabbing me | When I turned away until my heart from its fortresses, and patience from my beating heart no longer benefits me | My heart is infatuated with her and my eyes are her pastures, I die for her while she plants me to the wind | If the wind knew about these calm natures, it wouldn't shake my heart's branches until it bid me farewell | My basil and love planted in the heart, she drinks my veins and quenches me and satisfies me, like bees satisfied from flower nectar | My pride comes from the sweetest thing that starved me, and when her shyness embraces her humility, I embraced a night that encouraged me on its path | If her night travels, I would travel to sell it, good news that God lifts me from error, and I became after being against her, with her | If she's lost I'm lost, if she guides she elevates me, and if I see with my eyes my heart between her fingers, I prostrate to God, O God don't lose me | When she gets serious and gives me her tears to drink, I taught her what tears mean to lovers, tears are a voice when it courts her ears | She sees my voice and when I pass she hears me, by God I didn't obey her or listen to her, but love made me hear and made me obey | For the beautiful one whose streets are my arteries, the heart leads me while peace prevents me | Despite her humility, she embraced a night whose path encouraged me, if only her night would pass | I went to sell her, but neither man nor God lifted me from my fall, and I became after being against her, with her - if she is lost, I am lost | When she guides me I listen, and when I see with my eyes, my heart between her fingers, I prostrated to God, O God don't forsake me, and when it comes to seriousness | She gave me her tears to drink, I taught her what tears mean to lovers, what tears signify | A voice when it flirts with her ears, she sees my voice and when I pass by she hears me. By God, I never used to obey her or listen to her, but love made me listen and submit to the one whose veins are my streets. The heart leads me while peace prevents me

matla: أعرف اللي في قلبك من عيونك
text:
أعرف اللي في قلبك من عيونك
حبيبي دون ينطق به لسانك
إذا رفّت على عينك جفونك تترجم لي بما يخفي بيانك
وإذا ودك تعرف اللي يبونك تعال وبرّق في عيني
عيانك وشوف ملوك قلبي يعبدونك إذا أشرت لي بأطرف بنانك

translation_en: I know what's in your heart from your eyes, my beloved, without your tongue speaking it | When your eyelids flutter over your eyes, they translate for me what your expression hides | And if you want to know who loves you, come and look into my eyes | Look and see the kings of my heart worshipping you when you gesture to me with your fingertips | Your eyes witness how the kings of my heart worship you when you gesture to me with your fingertips

matla: ودنا بالطيب بس الدهر جحّاد طيب
text:
ودنا بالطيب بس الدهر جحّاد طيب
كل ما تخلص مع الناس كنك تغشها
ودنا بالطيب بس الدهر جحّاد طيب
كل ما تخلص مع الناس كنك تغشها
كل ما شبيت نار المحبة مع حبيب
قام يسحب في مشاهيبها ويرشها
يدك لا مدت وفاء لا تحرى وش تجيب
كان جاتك سالمة حب يدك وخشها
كل ماواجهت لك في الزمن وجه غريب
مثل ما قال المثل دام تمشي

كل ماواجهت لك في الزمن وجه غريب

جعل قشاش الحطب لا سَرح
يقتشها
poem_matla: ودنا بالطيب بس الدهر جحّاد طيب
title: ودنا بالطيب بس الدهر جحّاد طيب
translation_en: We desire goodness, but fate denies goodness / Whenever you are sincere with people, it's as if you deceive them | Whenever you kindle the fire of love with a beloved / They pull at its embers and extinguish it | If your hand extends in loyalty, don't expect what it brings / If it returns safely, kiss your hand and hide it | Whenever time falls silent, it's like a stranger's face / As the proverb says, as long as it walks, let it walk | This era doesn't care for what is right and proper / May the wood gatherer's straw, when it strays, be gathered | He began pulling at her gray hairs and sprinkling them | When your hand extends in loyalty, you don't know what it will bring | If greetings came to you, love your hand and enter it | And whenever silence befalls time, it's like the face of a stranger | As the proverb says, as long as you keep walking | When your hand extends in loyalty, you don't know what it will bring | If greetings came to you, love your hand and enter it | And whenever silence befalls time, it's like the face of a stranger | As the proverb says, as long as you keep walking | And a group that doesn't call for what is right and true | May the wood gatherer find no wood to gather | He adorned her/decorated her

matla: بعد غابت نجوم السماء من يقدّيني عن البال
text:
بعد غابت نجوم السماء من يقدّيني عن البال
وش يمنعك يا الطاري المرار
تمر ان بغيت تمر من بيني وبيني
وانا كل ما ناح الحمام بضمير وطار
تمنيت لو كانت يديني
جناحيني، هروبي بذاكرتي
عن مواجهة الأقدار
تكرر بيومياتي
وصار روتيني
أجوب الشوارع
والشوارع تجوب الدار
وسكون البيوت
يحرك اللي سكن فيني
من يديني أخذها الزمان بيديه
ودار وضاعت معاه أجمل سنيني
من يديني يا زوار خلوني على البال
يا زوار لو أن الوجود في بالها ما يكفيني
تغربت بأطواري وماني غريب أطوار
وغديت بليالينا ولا عاد يمديني
مثل من دخل غيبوبة وما درى وش صار
وبعد ما انتهت غيبوبته قال أنا ويني
مثل من دخل غيبوبة وما درى وش صار
وبعد ما انتهت غيبوبته
قال أنا ويني وحيد
وملت بالي طواري
وأنا محتار
بطاري يصبرني وطاري
يسريني، عليها
وأنا ما بيني وبينها
مشوار مسافة سهر
من جفني الذابل
لعيني لكن الظروف
اللي تعيق الوصال
كثار حدتني على الصمت
وحدتها تخليني
لذلك تقبلت المف
ـارق بدون اعذار وودعتها
ما كنها شي يعنيني
وراحت وقسّتها ليالي
وانا منهار
تبي من يذكرها
وأبي من ينسيني
poem_matla: بعد غابت نجوم السماء من يقدّيني عن البال
title: تبي من يذكّرها وأبي من ينسيني
translation_en: After the stars of the sky disappeared, who will guide me from thoughts | What prevents you, O bitter visitor | Pass if you wish to pass between me and myself | And I, whenever the dove coos with conscience and flies | I wished my hands could be | My wings, my escape in my memory | From facing destinies | Repeating in my daily life | And became my routine | I roam the streets | And the streets roam the house | And the stillness of homes | Moves what dwells within me | From my hands, time took her with its hands | And turned, and my best years were lost with it | Who will guide me, O visitors, leave me in thoughts | O visitors, if existence in her thoughts isn't enough for me | I became strange in my ways though I'm not strange of ways | And I became in our nights, no longer reaching me | Like one who entered a coma and didn't know what happened | And after his coma ended, he said where am I | Like one who entered a coma and didn't know what happened | And after his coma ended | He said where am I, alone | And my mind filled with thoughts | And I am confused | A thought that makes me patient and a thought | It pleases me, upon her | And there is nothing between me and her | A journey of staying awake through the night | From my withered eyelid | For my eyes, but the circumstances | The one who hinders the union | Many times they provoked me to silence | Her loneliness makes me | That's why I accepted the separation | Without excuses, I bid her farewell | It's as if it means nothing to me | And she left, and the nights were harsh to her | And I am collapsing | She wants someone to remember her | And I want someone who makes me forget

matla: نجرح دفتر الأوراق بالمسمار
text:
نجرح دفتر الأوراق بالمسمار
نكذب نكتب ونقطع جنون أحلام أطفالي
ولكن مثل ما تدري نويت أفركش الأسرار
أرتبها وأطلقها رصاص ما هو بخبالي
نعم هذا زمان الفاعل المفعول بالإصرار
زمان ما يعرف الرفق دام الجاني الغالي
هذا شيء بقوله دام هذا اليوم أنا المختار
ثرى هالأرض لأهل الأرض والله دائم عالي
أنا ما قلت لي بيت لأجل أكثر من الإهذار
ولكن الفتى يبقى نطق لأشياء تنقالي
poem_matla: نجرح دفتر الأوراق بالمسمار
title: نجرح دفتر الأوراق
translation_en: We wound the notebook of papers with a nail | We lie, we write, and cut off the madness of my children's dreams | But as you know, I intended to expose the secrets | I arrange them and release them as bullets, not from my imagination | Yes, this is the time of the subject made object by insistence | A time that knows no gentleness as long as the precious one is the criminal | This is something I'll say as long as today I am the chosen one | The soil of this earth belongs to the people of the earth, and God remains Most High | I didn't compose a verse just to ramble more | But the young man remains speaking of things that must be said

matla: طز فيك وطز في الدنيا
text:
طز فيك وطز في الدنيا
وأهلها، لا عليك
ولا على الدنيا
حسافة، مات ابو خبزة وجا غيره
وأكلها الحقيقة مؤلمة
يا أهل الخرافة

title: طز فيك وطز في الدنيا
translation_en: To hell with you and to hell with the world | And its people, I don't care about you | Nor about the world | What a pity, they didn't want bread and someone else came | And ate it, the truth is painful | O people of delusion

matla: ماني بمن يآتي ولا يدرى به، شطرٍ حفظته ما عرف كتّابه
text:
ماني بمن يآتي ولا يدرى به، شطرٍ حفظته ما عرف كتّابه
شطر يناسبني لمثل الليلة
واشوفني في ذا المكان أولى به
أبا أتّكل بالله ونعمٍ بالله
اللي ما يوصد دون خلقه بابه
بقول واللجنة تقيّم قولي
ومن كثرة الشعّار ماني آبه
الحمد لله واثقٍ من روحي
وإن كنت ذيب فالرجال ذيابة
ما أقول أنا أشعر واحد في العالم
لكن قصيدي كفو و انا أدرى به
الشعر جمعنا لو تفرقنا
حدودنا وظروفنا الغلابة
الله يبيض وجه راعي الفكرة
عز الله انها تنحسب لحسابه
والله يبيض وجه من يرعاها
محمد الله يحفظه لأحبابه
محمد ولد زايد عريب المجنى
ولي عهد الديرة الخلّابة
الشعر تاريخ لنا من مبطي
وإعلامنا يوم السنين نهابه
الشعر بيت والوزن عمدانه
معناه طنب وقافيته حجابه
الشعر وادٍ فيه صيد واجد
وكلً على الوادي يهجّ ركابه
والأفكار صيد
وكل شاعر قانص وكلً يدسم شاربه مخلابه
أحدٍ خياله حر وأحدٍ وكري
وأحدٍ خياله كوبجٍ بقطابه
وأنا خيالي كل ما هديته حوّل على الوادي وصاد عقابه
شاركت أمثّل ديرتي وربوعي
وكلٍ يمثّل ديرته وأقرابه
والله إذا الله راد والله قاله
إني لاسلّمها الفخر وكتابه
داري قطر، وأنا هنا أمثّلها
المجد مطلوبي وأنا طلابّه
عهدٍ علي إني لا أشرّف داري، ترّك صبي ما يعزّ ترابه
عهدٍ علي إني لا أشرّف داري، ترّك صبي ما يعزّ ترابه
شوفوا دمي من حبها عنابي وحماستي من ضوها شبابة
شاعر خليجي والعروبة بيتي والبيت ما يوقف بدون أطنابه
وإن عودت بين القبايل فزعة
أنا أشهد إن لي في اللوازم لابة
لي فالقبائل ربع وأقدّرهم
ماني بمن يجهل مقام أصحابه
وإن عوّدت لأصلي فأنا أصلي مرّي
من صلب يام أهل القنا وخضابه
قومٍ لنا فوق المعالي بيرق والسيف قوة سلته بنصابه
الشعر طوقني وأنا طوّقته
قمت أتمشى به و أفك أبوابه
يا بنت ياللي تفرقين بعودش
ما ألومهم لو كثروا الخطابة
لا مرّ بش دربش على خلق الله
قالوا كذا بالأصبع السبابة، زينش
يزينه فعل أبيش وجدش
وانتي بدورش للنقاء كسّابة
قومي تباهي بي وفلّي راسش
عليش من ستر الشرف جلبابة
وإن ما سترتش بالفعول و باسمي
فعقّبني الفنجال يا صبّابه
poem_matla: ماني بمن يآتي ولا يدرى به، شطرٍ حفظته ما عرف كتّابه
title: ماني بمن يآتي ولا يدرى به
translation_en: I am not one who comes without knowing, a verse I memorized whose writer is unknown | A verse that suits me for a night like this, and I see myself in this place most worthy of it | I want to rely on Allah, and what excellence in Allah, who doesn't close His door to His creation | I will speak and let the committee evaluate my words, and from the multitude of poets I am not concerned | Praise be to Allah, I am confident in myself, and if I am a wolf, then men are wolves | I don't say I'm the best poet in the world, but my poetry is worthy and I know it | Poetry gathered us though we are separated, our borders and overwhelming circumstances | May Allah honor the face of the idea's owner, by Allah's glory it counts in his favor | May Allah honor the face of who sponsors it, Mohammed may Allah preserve him for his loved ones | Mohammed bin Zayed of noble lineage, Crown Prince of the captivating homeland | Poetry has been our history from long ago, and our media when years were harsh | Poetry is a house and meter its pillars, meaning is its ropes and rhyme its curtain | Poetry is a valley with much prey, and everyone drives their mounts to the valley | Ideas are prey, every poet a hunter, each fattening their mustache with their talons | Some have free imagination, some a falcon, some imagination like a pigeon in a cage | My imagination whenever I guide it turns to the valley and hunts its eagle | I participated to represent my homeland and territories, each represents their homeland and relatives | By Allah if Allah wills and says it, I will hand it the pride and its book | My home is Qatar, and I'm here representing it, glory is my goal and I seek it | A pledge upon me not to honor my home like a boy who doesn't cherish its soil | See my blood from its love is grape-colored, my enthusiasm from its light is youthful | Poetry is a house and meter is its pillars | Its meaning is a tent rope and its rhyme is its veil | Poetry is a valley with abundant game | And everyone rushes their camels through the valley | And thoughts are prey | Every poet is a hunter and each anoints his mustache with his prey | One whose imagination is free and one who is a hireling | And someone whose imagination is like a nightmare in a train | And my imagination, whenever I calmed it, turned to the valley and hunted its eagle | I participated to represent my homeland and my territories | And each one represents his homeland and his relatives | By God, if God wills it, by God He has said it | I shall hand over to her the pride and its book | My homeland is Qatar, and I am here representing it | Glory is what I seek and I am its seeker | I vow that I will not honor my home, leaving a boy who does not cherish its soil | I vow that I will not honor my home, leaving a boy who does not cherish its soil | Look at my blood turned crimson from her love, and my passion from her light is youthful | I am a Gulf poet and Arabism is my home, and a home cannot stand without its tent ropes | And if you return as a source of support among the tribes | I bear witness that I have a need in necessities | I have allies among the tribes and I value them | I am not one who ignores the status of his companions | And if you return to my origin, then I am my origin's bitter one | From the lineage of those who wield spears and their blood-staining | A people for whom we have a banner above the heights, and the sword is a force drawn from its hilt | Poetry has embraced me and I have embraced it | I started walking with it and unlocking its doors | O girl, you who distinguish yourself with your fragrance | I don't blame them if they speak at length | When he passes by on his path among God's creation | They said thus with the index finger, how beautiful | His grandfather's and father's deeds adorn him | And you, in your turn, are a seeker/earner of purity | My people boast about me while I lower my head | Upon you is the cloak of honor's veil | And if you did not cover yourself with deeds and my name | So pass me the coffee cup, O coffee pourer

poem_matla: أنا لو اوزّع على الناس ابتساماتي
title: لا أوزّع على الناس ابتساماتي
translation_en: I don't distribute my smiles to people / O you with dead feelings, what can revive them? | 'You owe me' doesn't fatten my mustache / And people's actions don't match their principles | The opportunity is favorable and the topic is timely / And poetry is something that concerns me and I care for it | But it doesn't express my suffering / Unless it expresses the world and its outskirts | From a quarter-century experience my self has lived / Not every separation shakes the heart when mentioned | Except the empress of my heart and my desires / She stirs in the pool of my heart with her feet | O first love station of my stations / Nights that gathered me with you to water them | I come with my great ambitions / And leave having given her everything | And for you my heart behind the ribs doesn't sleep / Nor approaches your home when I intend to | Like a GMC that distances don't intimidate / Experienced in the world's beginning and end | Its slaughter when I meet the long-nosed ones / Like a docile camel that increases its owner's pride | And its mirrors before its hood are wide / Like the palms of an imam with a prayer he prays | And the horn honks with my honks / It ignites fire and doesn't extinguish it | Upon it the living enter the realm of the dead / And upon it the dead, I don't know where I take them | Between it and the people of Najd no relations / Neither does it approach them nor they approach it | And its sound like Ibn Murra's wind after my roar / The sigh of one burned by love's rejection | Leaning toward love with sighs / But finding no one in love to lean with her | And its wipers when they stand to kiss and come / Like an old woman's finger with many prayers | And its mudflaps when lined with bumps / Like a pampered girl's hips being trained | When hit by strong wind / She feels it's trying to flip her | And he won't come near your home the day I intend to visit it | Like a wild camel that distances do not intimidate | Wandering aimlessly through the beginning and end of this world | From his throat, I do not accept with the nose of the arrogant ones | A slaughtered camel that feeds on its herder's liver | And his mirror without his stumble are my broad ones | The hands of an imam with a prayer that he calls upon | And the Hawli sprays/splashes | From his throat, I do not accept with the nose of the arrogant ones | A slaughtered camel that feeds on its herder's liver | And his mirror without his stumble are my broad ones | The hands of an imam with a prayer that he calls upon | And the Hawli (pearl diver) dives and his diving matches my diving | He ignites the fire but never extinguishes it | Upon him the living enter the realm of the dead | And upon it are the dead, I don't know where to take them | There are no relations between him and the people of Najd | Neither does she come close to him nor does he come close to her | There are no relations between him and the people of Najd | She doesn't come close to him, nor does he come close to her | And his voice when the wind of Ibn Murra comes after my provisions | The sigh of one whose heart is burned by love's rejection | Sighing for love with deep breaths | And she found no one in love to stand by her side | And its two areas when they rise to kiss and come | The finger of an old woman with many complaints | And its two areas when they rise to kiss and come | The finger of an old woman with many complaints | And its fluttering wings when they line up at the speed bumps | The curves of a girl from blessings/nobility | You train her when I butt heads with her | And its fluttering when it lines up at the speed bumps, flaws of a girl from privilege | You train her, when the fierce gentle wind strikes her | You feel that he is following/tracking you from the group | The jackhammer has grown, its children and daughters | The Lexus, the Porsche, the BMW and its siblings | If I said O pocket, befriend him, it said I don't care | But his religion has its followers who support it | He drinks my coffee cups and breaks my glasses | And he extends his leg across my path and bends it | And I said O Ford, the Ford said my silence | Some paths you don't want to encounter them | The GMC is creativity from all my directions | As if your poem is the one that is upon it | A source/origin to Fujairah with a Croatian name | He studies the sciences of nature in its aspects | He bought it, a Saudi from an Emirati | He sold to a Hadhrami who was leaving with it | A source to Fujairah with a Croatian name, studying natural sciences in its surroundings | He bought it, a Saudi from an Emirati who sold it to a Hadhrami who's going with it | The Hadrami, whenever he stores qat, whatever is on his mind he will do it | He sold to a Hadhrami who was doomed in it, and the Hadhrami whenever he stored from the khat | The need that's on his mind, he does it without hesitation | The thoughts of my heart and the last of my verses, my poems, every one of them you have heard | Yes by God, I have loved your satisfaction with my very essence, there is no space in my heart that you have not walked through | Oh my sweet Nile | Oh my Tigris | Oh my Euphrates | O homeland of love | Her street | And her pride | And oh most eloquent poem | Upon her are my movements | Nothing brings wonder to my eyes | Her reader/One who reads her | Let the tears of your eyes scatter | Do as I do | Tell me, is it like this in your sleeve | Then he walked her away

text:
أنا أكثر انسان التقي فيه ابليس، وابليس ماهو انسان لكن بأنّسه، هالوقت كله بالقلب، واسأل الكيس العدل ولا الظلم يا اللي مكيّس؟ نحضر عزاء ودموع خلفه معاريس هذا دفن والده وهذا يعرّس دنيا وأقدار وصراحة
وأباليس وغيبة ونميمة وكذب كل حد يمارس
يلعب معانا الغرب شطرنج وبقيس كنس ملكنا والشعب صار يكنس
يلعب معانا الغرب شطرنج وبقيس، كنس ملكنا والشعب صار يكنس، علم العروبة لو وقف فيه تنكيس
ما دام حال الواقع اعوام منكس

title: مصعب الفطيسي - وطنية
translation_en: Subscribe to the channel | Devils, backbiting, gossip and lies - everyone practices | The West plays chess with us, sweeping our king while the people sweep | The flag of Arabism, even if it stands at half-mast | As long as the state of reality remains years of setback | And the poetry of Arabism, even if smoothed and polished | I saw the Arabs become smooth from sucking their own blood | But our Arabs have gone | And the people of hardships even licked the empty plate clean | But our Arabs have gone | And the people of hardships even licked the empty plate | Jerusalem, its walls are the features of the oppressed | He wishes to feel that people hold him sacred | And death in Damascus is still at its peak | And the child in his mother's womb, death kicked | And we repeat without action or principles | Our subject is years that no one has felt | We repeat without action or principles | Our matter has been years with no one feeling it | Generally, sometimes we chat on Facebook | And we forget the worries and every injustice we touch | And on Facebook there's a woman whose beauty makes one forget | I wish I was the only one who always breathes/exists | And on Facebook | In her beauty there are gentle breezes | I wish I was the only one who always breathes/exists | You take Yara's waist | And the features of Lamees | And every face | Her face has no equal, it bankrupts comparison | The one you reject, what is his anger with speculation | And whoever speaks to her thinks she's flirting | When she passes by you, she takes you to Paris | And every perfume in Paris, you sit and whisper/murmur | When she passes by you, she takes you to Paris | And every perfume in Paris, you sit and whisper/murmur | When she sleeps, the moon sleeps in nightmares | And if you wish to visit the morning and breathe | But distance took her away | And distance is the foundation of wounds | Oh you who makes every relationship a competition | And if breaths stopped in my eyes, weary and exhausted | And the face is cold, I wish you would come to warm it with sunshine | And I believe that sorrow produces feelings | Poetry is a mosque and mediocrity defiles it | Some stopped and some left while I remain accompanied by devils | O Lord, forgive me if I have been a companion

matla: البنت من رجالها والخيل من خيالها
text:
البنت من رجالها والخيل من خيالها
والضبعة العرجاء تحوم تبي عشاء لعيالها
هذا من الشعر القديم ما قالها
أمثال من قول البدو مدري من اللي قالها
الفطن يفهم مقصدي، ومالي ومالك
لا ضاقت الدنيا علي، سلمى تهز جبالها
ما أضيق لو غيري يضيق وما هو موقّف لي طريق
وعيال شمر لابتي صكت علي رجالها
ما اضيق لو غيري يضيق وماهو موقف لي طريق وعيال شمّر لابتي صكت علي رجالها عبدة مع الصايح جميع والشمرية ما تضيع
شمر ليا ضاق الزمن كلٍ يقول أنا لها
وانا غريري يا بعدي
حفيد بن حاتم عدي
عيال عدي العدوات
كلٍ يعرف أفعالها
يا بنت قومي والعبي
ابا اتفاخر بنسبي
من غبنها بعض النفوس يصيبها سلالها
تفاخري بي يا مرة
الذل ما فيه ثمرة
كم سربة من ذلها كلٍ شرب فنجالها
صرنا طنايا من طنا
ما هو طرب ولا غناء
صرنا طنايا من طنا ما هو طرب ولا غناء
أشد لحظات الزعل فال الله ولا فالها
وما فيه نجدي وجزري، الشمري
هو شمري، بأي ديرةٍ فيها نزل زمّ الحمول وشالها
وفيني حميّا وأسلمي ولا لحيسة محزمي
لا عدت بيوت العرب متشيد منزالها
وان صرت عبدي ضيغمي سنعوس دمي ولحمي
عبدة سناعيس الفخر تعجز تعد أبطالها
وان قلت أنا زوبع فخر أهل المراجل والسطر
شيوخ شمر منهم اللي يظل ظلالها
عرّب وليدك عرّبه وكاس المراجل شربه
وخل العلوم مفرقة من دقها وجلالها ما يزعل الناس المديح
خص إذا مدحك صحيح والعفن تلقى المرجلة تقصر عليه حبالها
واعرف ولو طال الزمن
الطيب يبقى له ثمن
واعرف ترى نفسك تبي تجزا بنوع أعمالها
وانا ولاني مستضيق
ولا هو موقف لي طريق
وعيال شمر لابتي صكت علي رجالها
ولا عليكم زود

title: البنت من رجالها
translation_en: A girl is known by her men, and horses by their riders | And the limping hyena circles seeking dinner for her cubs | This is from ancient poetry, not what he said | Proverbs from Bedouin sayings, I don't know who said them | The wise understands my purpose, what's mine and yours | When the world becomes narrow for me, Salma shakes its mountains | I don't feel constrained when others do, nothing blocks my path | And the sons of Shammar, when I called, their men answered | Abda with all who call, and the Shammari never lose | Shammar, when times are hard, each says 'I am for her' | And I am Ghurairi, oh my distance | Grandson of Ibn Hatim Adi | The sons of Adi of the raids | Everyone knows their deeds | Oh girl, rise and play | I want to boast of my lineage | From its injustice, some souls suffer consumption | Boast of me, oh woman | Humiliation bears no fruit | How many groups from their humiliation, everyone drank their cups | We became echoes from our echoing | Not joy nor singing | We became echoes from our echoing, not joy nor singing | The harshest moments of anger, may God not bring them | There's no Najdi or Jaziri, the Shammari | He is a Shammar tribesman, in whichever land he settles, he gathers the caravans and leads them | I have passion within me, so surrender, and don't let confusion bind you | May the houses of Arabs not be rebuilt after their destruction | And if you become my slave, my lion, fierce and proud, my blood and flesh | The servants of glory's banners, unable to count their heroes | And if I said I am a whirlwind, the pride of brave men and lineage | The sheikhs of Shammar, among them are those whose shade remains | Arabize your child, Arabize him, and let him drink from the cup of manhood | Leave the sciences scattered in their minutiae and grandeur, praise does not upset people | Especially when your praise is true and the rotten one finds that manliness's ropes fall short of reaching him | And I know, even if time stretches long | Goodness always has its price | And know that your soul will be rewarded according to its deeds | And I am not distressed | And it is not a position for me to take a path | And the sons of Shammar, when my tribe called upon its men | And it's no burden upon you

matla: قالوا أبهق قال ذا موضة جديدة، والتفت وقلت يسعد لي مساكم جاكم اللي ما تتعبه القصيدة ان بغى يتعب عليها قال جاكم وان تعذّرها المحرر في الجريدة والله ان اكتب على طوفة حداكم
text:
قالوا أبهق قال ذا موضة جديدة، والتفت وقلت يسعد لي مساكم جاكم اللي ما تتعبه القصيدة ان بغى يتعب عليها قال جاكم وان تعذّرها المحرر في الجريدة والله ان اكتب على طوفة حداكم
اتشفّق لسعد ولا نشيده لا قعد يجذبكم ويرجعكم وراكم وابو خالد المسافات البعيدة ان بغيته شاعر ولا ملاكم
لا تغنى كنه يسحب من رصيده ما يسد افواه ثلثين أفقراكم، يا كويت المرجلة فرصة سعيدة
ويا جماهير المعزة وش بلاكم الصراحة والحقيقة والوكيدة داءكم طيبتكم وحبي دواكم
تحملون أمراض الأفكار الحميدة الله لا يعافيكم من اللي بلاكم
لو صلاة الله تضمنها عبيده والله ان اقول صلى الله عليكم
والبهق فوائده فعلا عديدة كيف بفهمكم وبكسب رضاكم
لو حداكم شافني وسط الجريدة ثم يقابلني في شارع قال جاكم
poem_matla: قالوا أبهق قال ذا موضة جديدة، والتفت وقلت يسعد لي مساكم جاكم اللي ما تتعبه القصيدة ان بغى يتعب عليها قال جاكم وان تعذّرها المحرر في الجريدة والله ان اكتب على طوفة حداكم
title: جاكم اللي ما تتعبه القصيدة
translation_en: They said 'Albahaq', he said this is a new trend, and I turned and said good evening to you. The one who isn't troubled by poetry has come to you, if he wants to trouble himself with it, he said he came to you. And if the editor rejects it in the newspaper, by God I'll write on the edge beside you | I sympathize with Saad and won't praise him, lest he sits pulling you and bringing you back. Abu Khalid of the long distances, if you want him as a poet or your angel | Don't sing as if he withdraws from his balance what doesn't fill the mouths of two-thirds of your poor. O Kuwait of manliness, a happy opportunity | O crowds of affection, what's your affliction? Frankness, truth, and certainty - your illness is your kindness and my love is your cure | You carry the diseases of benevolent thoughts, may God not cure you from what afflicts you | If God's prayer were guaranteed by His servant, by God I would say may God's prayers be upon you | And albahaq has many benefits indeed, how can I make you understand and gain your satisfaction | If one of you sees me in the middle of the newspaper then meets me in the street, he'll say 'he came to you'

poem_matla: البارحة ربي كتب لي ولفيت
title: البارحة ربي كتب لي ولفيت
translation_en: Last night, God decreed for me and I encountered | I don't want people to know about my encounter | But against my will, tears flowed from my eyes | My tears were confused in my eyes and I turned away | I blinked wanting them not to show, but they fell | After that, lightning flashed in my eyes and I was watered | My cheeks and chest collided together | And I thought I had recovered from his separation | And that my tears had moved away from the entrance of sustenance | Those who think I've adapted to the distance | Or that my eyes have surrendered to sleep | I wish I had turned back before I loved him | Or that my paths had diverged from his paths | It would be easier for me than crying and lamenting | And better than barriers that revealed themselves to people | I learned how the living differs from the dead | And I knew the value of my blessing when it departed | Tell him that after his departure I deteriorated | And my feet turned away from the paths of the healed | Distance is fire and obeying blame is sulfur | His distance falls short | Indeed, the liver has exhaled its pain

matla: اكذبي يا سندريلا ملّي الدنيا بكذوبك
text:
اكذبي يا سندريلا ملّي الدنيا بكذوبك
خلي العالم تصدق في سعادات النهاية
رتبي كل الحوادث سيري الأحداث صوبك
انت بس ويا حبيبك
انت بس ويا حبيبك وسط جنات خلايا
خلي العالم تصفق من وراء أذيال ثوبك
رقصتك كانت وحيدة في سويعات البداية
كان بك الماس يتدلى من حلا ورقة كعوبك
ما التقطه إنسان بعدك
ما التقطه إنسان بعده وعدتي من ضمن الحفايا
بسألك بس ليه كذبتي وإنتي نفّضتي جيوبك
لا حبيبك هو حبيبك ولا جرى خلف السرايا
يمكن إنتي يمكن إنتي بس ركضتي خلف ما صور
سروبك فارسك غيرك ترجى
وتركك خلف الملايا
لو بكيتي
لو لهفتي
ما اومى بنظراته صوبك
خر من ثوب المحبة
جسم سالي به الغوايا
انزعي ثوب الخطية
انزعي ثوب الخطية
واغسلي دفة ذنوبك
انت شرعتي غرام
فاقد زوج الثنايا
اكذبي يا سندريلا
وملّي الدنيا كذوبك
طبعي كذبتك الف نسخة
و وزعي بين البرايا
poem_matla: اكذبي يا سندريلا ملّي الدنيا بكذوبك
title: اكذبي يا سندريلا
translation_en: Lie, O Cinderella, fill the world with your lies | Let the world believe in happy endings | Arrange all incidents, direct events toward you / You alone with your beloved | You alone with your beloved amidst paradise cells | Let the world applaud behind your dress trains | Your dance was solitary in the beginning hours | Diamonds dangled from the sweetness of your heel's curve | No human picked it up after you / No human picked it up after him, and you returned among the barefoot | I ask you why you lied when you emptied your pockets | Your beloved is not your beloved, nor did he run behind the palaces | Perhaps you just ran after what your paths depicted / Your knight is someone else who returns and left you behind the veils | If you cried, if you yearned / He didn't gesture toward you | He fell from love's garment / A body through which temptations flowed | Remove the dress of sin / Remove the dress of sin and wash away your sins | You legislated love / Missing a pair of front teeth | Lie, O Cinderella, and fill the world with your lies / Print your lie in a thousand copies and distribute among people | If only my yearning | He doesn't gesture with his glances towards you | The hem of love's garment has fallen | A body that distractions have afflicted | Take off the garment of sin | Take off the garment of sin | And wash away the burden of your sins | You are my law of love | Missing the pair of front teeth | Lie, O Cinderella | And fill the world with your lies | My nature has copied your lie a thousand times | And distribute me among the people

matla: على الهون يا جرح المفارق وضيق البال
text:
على الهون يا جرح المفارق وضيق البال
على الهون يا همٍ من سطى بي وقدرته
أعزك لو انك جرح ومجاهدك
قتّال، وروّضت جسمي لأجل سقمك
وصبرته لأجل من ملك قلبي
من الجال لين الجال
وفجيت له بابٍ عن الناس سكرته
وحطيت له عن شمس قيظ الغرام
ظلال وشيّدت له بيتٍ بقلبي
وعمرته حفظته ودللته وغنيت له موال
وتخيرت قربه ليتني ما تخيرته
حفظته ودللته وغنيت له موال
وتخيّرت قربه ليتني ما تخيرته
رعى ريف قلبي لين صار الحشم مدهال
وعن مدهله جنّبت غيره وذيّرته
أداري عليه من الزعل وأزعل العذال
وخطاه إن كبر في عين غيري
تصاغرته سقيته من عدود الغلا والغرام زلال
بعد ما جذب من دم قلبي وصدرته
وقبل لا يغطي ليله المنتثر بالشال
سرقت الكرى من نون عينه وسهرته
ونقش كل حرف من حروفي على السلسال
تباهى بها وأغاظ ناسٍ مجاكرته
وبعد كل هالتقدير والحب والإجلال
تغير و هقواته عليه مغيرته
تكاثر علي الله يجازيه كيف الحال
وأنا يوم أسوق العمر له ما تكاثرته
تكاثر علي الله يجازيه كيف الحال
وأنا يوم أسوق العمر له ما تكاثرته
لبسته ثياب الغطرسة لين جاء يختال
و كبر في عيونه يوم الأوهام غررته
و إذا السالفة ضحك و مهازل
مهازل ولعب عيال
خبطت الغصن
لين أبرق الريش طيرته
خلصنا وقفلنا الصناديق
بالأقفال ومن جور حكمه كامل
القلب حررته
poem_matla: على الهون يا جرح المفارق وضيق البال
title: على الهون يا جرح المفارق
translation_en: Take it easy, O wound of separation and distress of mind / Take it easy, O sorrow that has overpowered me with its might | I honor you even as a wound whose struggle is deadly / And I've trained my body for your sickness and made it patient | For the one who possessed my heart from journey to journey / And I opened for them a door that I had closed to others | I placed shade for them from the scorching sun of passion / And built them a house in my heart and maintained it | I preserved them, pampered them, and sang them songs / And chose their nearness - if only I hadn't chosen it | They grazed the meadow of my heart until the grass became barren / And from its barrenness I kept others away | I protect them from anger and anger the critics / Their faults, if great in others' eyes, I minimize | I gave them pure water of passion and love / After they drew from my heart's blood | Before night covered them with a shawl / I stole sleep from their eyes and kept them awake | I engraved every letter of mine on the chain / They boasted with it and angered those who envied | After all this appreciation, love and reverence / They changed and their whims overcame them | They multiplied against me - may God judge them / While I gave them my life without counting | I dressed them in arrogance until they came strutting / Growing in their own eyes when illusions deceived them | If it's all jokes and child's play / I shook the branch until the bird flew away | We finished and locked the boxes with locks / And from their unjust rule, I freed my heart completely | I conceal my anger from him while angering the blamers | And his steps, even if they seem great in others' eyes | I belittled him, yet gave him to drink from the wells of passion and love's pure water | After he drew from my heart's blood and expelled it | And before the night covers the scattered one with a shawl | I stole sleep from the pupil of his eye and kept him awake | And I engraved every letter of my letters on the chain | He boasted with it and angered people who confronted him | And after all this appreciation, love, and reverence | He changed and his desires have overcome him | May God reward whoever asks me frequently how I am | And when I drive my life towards him, I do not multiply it | May God reward whoever asks me frequently 'how are you?' | And when I drive my life towards him, I do not multiply it | He wore the garments of arrogance until he came strutting | And he grew arrogant in his eyes when illusions deceived him | And if the matter becomes laughter and jokes | Jokes and children's play | I struck the branch | Until the feather flashed and made it fly | We finished and closed the boxes | With locks and from the tyranny of his complete judgment | I freed the heart

matla: تضحك ويغمرني الضحك تبكي تبكيني معاك لو كان تخفي تفضحك عينك وتكشف وش بلاك أرجوك خلي وأنصحك تعطف على من هو هواك من عاش عمره يمنحك حبه ويتمنى رضاك مادام وزنك ير
text:
تضحك ويغمرني الضحك تبكي تبكيني معاك لو كان تخفي تفضحك عينك وتكشف وش بلاك أرجوك خلي وأنصحك تعطف على من هو هواك من عاش عمره يمنحك حبه ويتمنى رضاك مادام وزنك ير
جحك في الحب عن منهم سواك والناس دايم
تمدحك بالطيب وتوصف
غواك أغفر
وسامح واسمحك
وامسح خطانا في عداك
أخسر حياتي وأربحك
ما تنفع الدنيا بلاك
poem_matla: تضحك ويغمرني الضحك تبكي تبكيني معاك لو كان تخفي تفضحك عينك وتكشف وش بلاك أرجوك خلي وأنصحك تعطف على من هو هواك من عاش عمره يمنحك حبه ويتمنى رضاك مادام وزنك ير
title: تضحك ويغمرني الضحك
translation_en: You laugh and laughter overwhelms me, you cry and I cry with you. Even if you try to hide, your eyes betray you and reveal what troubles you | I beg you, let me advise you - be gentle with the one who loves you. The one who lived his life granting you his love and wishing for your satisfaction | As long as your worth outweighs all others in love, and people always praise you for your goodness and describe your allure | I forgive and pardon and allow you, and erase our mistakes in your enmity. I lose my life but win you - the world is worthless without you | And forgive, and I forgive you | And erase our mistakes in your enmity | I lose my life and win you | The world is of no use without you

matla: يقول يا عظيمة كل شيء له حدود وله نهاية
text:
يقول يا عظيمة كل شيء له حدود وله نهاية
لكن انت ما وقفتي عند حدك يا عظيمة استلذيتي بطعناتي واخذتيها هواية
كن مالك حربةٍ توجع وطعنات أليمة
آه ليتك ما تماديتي بطعنات البداية لأن صار الكل طعنة في الحشا
معنى وقيمة الله يبيحك ولكن كيف في أغرب رواية تكتبين الحب كذبة والهوى دقة
قديمة وانتي اللي كل ما لدت
عيونك في المراية
ما لمحتي إلا اليتيم اللي خذت قلبه
يتيمة واليتيمة في اليتامى
ما لها حق الوصاية
الوصية عودها الغضّ
ونواياها السليمة لكن انتِ صار
لك حق الوصاية والولاية
واستبديتي وشدوا البدو
وأضحيتي مقيمة ما رحلتي
لين حطمتي بما فيه
الكفاية عاقلٍ حب الجنون
وصوت نارك
في هشيمة استبحتي حرمة المجنون
بإدراك وعناية
والتفتي له بعقلك وارتكزتي
في صميمه من كثر ما يعشقك
ما قال لك بالحب رأيه
خايف الأيام لا تطلع عواقبها
وخيمة في طريقك كل ما كنه
لمس درب الهداية
تاه ودروب الحياة المستقيمة
مستقيمة تايه بصري
ومن جابه لبيت الله
تايه عذر من غمض بعين
وعينه الأخرى كريمة
فدوتك ما فات من الأيام
واللي عاد جاية يا بعد عمرٍ
مخاسيره معاك عندي غنيمة
أنتِ الفارع بقدّ وجدّ وأسماء وكناية
من عشق مثلك يجوز من الهوى واشتاق ريمة
ليه لا وانتي بحسنك في ذوات الحسن آية
لا ذهب لا ماس لا ياقوت لا أحجار كريمة
شاعرٍ له مع أهل الرايات في المرقاب
راية كل ما هبت هبوبك فلها قدر
وحشيمة سامحك من ألف باء الذنب
إلى مالا نهاية واستباحك عن خطاه وكل طقة
بتعليمه يوم قلتي أعطني حريتي
أطلق يدايه
ما ذخر عن وجهك
الا طعنتين
في صميمه
الله الله
صح لسانك
صح لسانك
poem_matla: يقول يا عظيمة كل شيء له حدود وله نهاية
title: يا عظيمة
translation_en: He says, O great one, everything has limits and an end | But you didn't stop at your limit, O great one, you took pleasure in my wounds and made them a hobby | As if you have no spear that hurts and painful stabs | Oh, if only you hadn't continued with the initial stabs, for now every stab is in the heart | Meaning and value, may God forgive you, but how in the strangest story you write love as a lie and passion as an old tune | Old, and you're the one who whenever you look at your eyes in the mirror | You only glimpsed the orphan whose heart you took | An orphan girl, and the orphan girl among orphans has no right to guardianship | The guardianship is for the tender branch and pure intentions | But you gained the right of guardianship and authority | You became tyrannical and the Bedouins departed, and you became a resident | You didn't leave until you destroyed enough in him | A sane person who loved madness and the sound of your fire in dry grass | You violated the sanctity of the madman with awareness and care | You turned to him with your mind and settled in his core | From how much he loves you, he didn't tell you his opinion about love | Afraid the days might reveal dire consequences | In your path, whenever he touched the path of guidance | He got lost, and the straight paths of life are straight | Lost is my sight, and whoever brought him to God's house is lost | Excuse for one who closed one eye while his other eye is generous | In his very core from how much he loves you | He didn't tell you his opinion about love | I fear the days lest their consequences emerge | And a tent in your path whenever it exists | He touched the path of guidance | He got lost while the paths of life are straight | Straight yet my sight is lost/wandering | And whoever brought him to the House of God | Lost is the excuse of one who closed an eye | And his other eye is generous | I sacrifice myself for you, for what has passed of the days | And what is yet to come, oh after a lifetime | My losses with you are a treasure to me | You are the tall one in stature, lineage, names and titles | Whoever loves someone like you is justified in passion and longing for a gazelle | Why not, when you with your beauty are a miracle among the beautiful ones | No gold, no diamonds, no rubies, no precious stones | A poet who has dealings with the flag bearers at the watchtower | A banner that whenever your winds blow, it has destiny and worth | And out of shame, I forgive you from the very beginning of the sin | Until infinity and permitted you from his steps and every knock | By his teaching when you said give me my freedom | He releases his hands | Nothing is spared from your face | Except for two stabs | In his very core/essence | God, God | Your tongue speaks truth | Your tongue speaks truth

matla: لا تلوّح للمسافر المسافر راح
text:
لا تلوّح للمسافر المسافر راح
ذبلت أنوار الشوارع وانطفأ
ضي الحروف
يلا يا قلبي سرينا
ضاقت الدنيا علينا
القطار
وفاتنا والمسافر راح
مدري باكر
هالمدينة
وش تكون
النهار
والورد الأصفر
والغصون هذا وجهك المسافر
لما كانت لي
وينها عيوني حبيبي
سافرت مثلك حبيبي القطار وفاتنا ومسافر
poem_matla: لا تلوّح للمسافر المسافر راح
title: المسافر
translation_en: Don't wave to the traveler, the traveler has gone | The streetlights have wilted and extinguished | The light of letters | Come my heart, let's go | The world has become narrow upon us | The train | Missed us and the traveler has gone | I don't know tomorrow | This city | What will it become | The day | And the yellow rose | And the branches, this is your traveling face | When I had | Where are my eyes, my beloved | I traveled like you my beloved, the train missed us and is traveling

matla: وكّل أمرك للكريم ويسمح أمرك كل مادكت على بالك روابع وافرد همومك على سجاد صبرك لا تضيقها وحلم الله واسع واعرف اسباب الردى والطيب وادره واحسب حسابك من الليلة وطالع لا تطاول في قصير الشبر شبرك
text:
وكّل أمرك للكريم ويسمح أمرك كل مادكت على بالك روابع وافرد همومك على سجاد صبرك لا تضيقها وحلم الله واسع واعرف اسباب الردى والطيب وادره واحسب حسابك من الليلة وطالع لا تطاول في قصير الشبر شبرك
ولا تنازل عن شيمك ولا تراجع ولا تسمع باهتين الذوق شعرك
وأنت شعرك من عروق البرق راضع وزم روحك بين جنحانك ووكرك
كان ما عندك على النوماس مانع ولا تواضع للوضيع يضيع قدرك
ما أنت مجبور على بعض التواضع
اشتركوا في القناة
poem_matla: وكّل أمرك للكريم ويسمح أمرك كل مادكت على بالك روابع وافرد همومك على سجاد صبرك لا تضيقها وحلم الله واسع واعرف اسباب الردى والطيب وادره واحسب حسابك من الليلة وطالع لا تطاول في قصير الشبر شبرك
title: وكّل أمرك للكريم
translation_en: Entrust your affairs to the Generous One and He will ease your matters, whenever troubles weigh upon your mind | Do not compromise your noble character nor retreat, and do not let those lacking taste diminish your worth | Your worth springs from the roots of lightning, so restrain your soul between your wings and nest | If you have nothing to offer people, do not humble yourself to the lowly lest they diminish your worth | You are not obligated to show humility to everyone | Subscribe to the channel

matla: هذه أنتي
text:
هذه أنتي
ما أصدق أنچ انتي
حن قلبك لي وتذكرتي ورجعتي
شو الي جابچ
وانا كل همي أصبر قلبي عنك
وأبعد الذكرى اللي تصرخ
كل لحظة من رحلتي
وهذه أنتي
ما أصدق أنچ انتي
انتظرتك
أنا والشوق وتمنيتك على غفلة تجيني
تذكري العشرة اللي مرت يا الحبيبة
وتذكريني
بس طال الانتظار
والأمل
ضيعته في ليل ونهار
واقتنعت أنك بعدتي
وما يردچ لي حنيني
شو الي جابچ
وأنا كل همي أغفّل قلبي عنك
وأبعد الذكرى اللي تطرق
كل لحظة من رحلتي
يا هلا جيتي وهدمتي جسر صبري اللي بنيته بالدموع
يا هلا جيتي ورجعتيني للماضي وانا ما أنوي الرجوع
غصب عني هز قلبي الشوق وعيوني دمعت
غبتي عن عيني وأثر يا عمري كنتي في الضلوع
وهذه انتي ما اصدق انچ انتي
poem_matla: هذه أنتي
title: هذه أنتي
translation_en: Here you are, I can't believe it's you | Your heart softened for me, you remembered and returned | What brought you back, when all my concern was to make my heart patient without you | And distance the memories that scream every moment of my journey | Here you are, I can't believe it's you | I waited for you, me and longing, and wished you'd come to me unexpectedly | Remember the companionship that passed, oh beloved, and remember me | But the waiting prolonged, and hope I wasted in night and day | And I became convinced you had gone far, and my yearning wouldn't bring you back | What brought you back, when all my concern was to distract my heart from you | And distance the memories that knock every moment of my journey | Welcome, you came and demolished the bridge of patience I built with tears | Welcome, you came and returned me to the past when I didn't intend to return | Against my will, longing shook my heart and my eyes teared | You disappeared from my sight, but oh my life, you remained in my ribs | Here you are, I can't believe it's you | And I became convinced that you are my distance | And my longing does not bring you back to me | What brought you here | And all my concern is to make my heart heedless of you | And I distance the memory that knocks | Every moment of my journey | Welcome, you came and destroyed the bridge of my patience that I built with tears | Welcome, you came and took me back to the past, while I have no intention of returning | Against my will, longing shook my heart and my eyes shed tears | You were absent from my eyes, and oh my life, you remained in my ribs | And here you are, I can't believe it's you

poem_matla: أنا قلت يا نسيم البر بسألك
title: يا نسيم البر
translation_en: I said, O breeze of the land, I will ask you / How is the state of the blissful one from Al-Oudi | He said his state is different from yours / In happiness and his days are fortunate | And you, O tormented one, the perishing / No one asks about you, nor are you sought | One who rests like your resting place / Does not spend nights conversing with the dunes | I said I am patient on that / Bound by faith and my covenants | He said don't let it cross your mind / That that time will return | I said I am owned and the owner / Has contracts of his ownership over me | He said I pity your state / But I have no purpose with him | How many like you have died / Because of the softness of cheeks | I told him may rain fall on your orbit / Don't blame the generous people | My way and your way are complete / In preservation, O gentle one of the dunes | And my aspiration/desire | And my aspiration/desire | The one who takes a midday rest like your resting place | Your midday rest | He doesn't stay up conversing with the oud | The one who calls/summons | I said I am patient | This is a dialogue with the wind | Yes, indeed | I said I am patient with that | Bound by faith and my covenants | My promises/covenants | He said don't let it cross your mind that those times will return | He will return | I said I am the owned/enslaved one | And the owner has my contracts for my possession with him | He said I am concerned about your condition | And I have no intention regarding it | How many of mine have died from the likes of you | And the reason is the blush of my cheeks | The cheeks | I told him may fortune be yours, do not blame the generous people | God is greatest | My pattern and your pattern remain preserved, O gentle one of generosity | God is greatest

poem_matla: كنت أمسي في حديقة منزلي في الرياض
title: يا ضايق الصدر
translation_en: I was spending the evening in my home garden in Riyadh | I was in the company of a generous brother and dear friend | And he is present with us now, Prince Khalid bin Fahd bin Khalid | And I was walking with him | I don't know what happened to us that night | We were all silent, just walking, walking, walking | And suddenly | He let out that groan | He sighed deeply | I said: May you be safe | What's wrong, Khalid? | He said: What's wrong with me? What have I done? | I burned half of our trees | With your sigh | He said: By God, it doesn't matter | Anyway, we walked a bit more | I said: O troubled heart, by God, ease your mind | Your world, my brother, is not worth the distress | He said: Did I ask you? | I said: What? He said: Don't say 'my brother' | I said: Why, my brother? | He said: Find something gentle, find something soft, find something | I said: Why? He said: I want to enjoy it too with you | I said: Fine, we trust in God | O troubled heart | O troubled heart, by God | Ease your mind | Your world, O beautiful one | You don't deserve the distress | God is capable of relieving your distress | And God has the judgment/authority | In the aftermath of his creatures | Beautiful eyes | Is it so soft and pleasant, O Khalid? | Oh you with the troubled heart | By God, ease the heart/mind | Your world, oh beautiful one | You don't deserve the distress | God is capable of relieving your distress | And by God, He has the right | In the aftermath of his creatures | The beautiful eyes have captivated me | Her falling tears | Stop the cloaks, stop the cloaks, the tears are sad and I cannot bear them | Sorrows of grief, sorrows, sorrows of grief overshadow your pure face | Veils of sorrow cover your pure face | And the roses in your cheeks, it's forbidden to drown them | The beautiful eyes were captivated by their flowing tears | The hem of the abayas | The hem of the abayas, tears of sorrow | I cannot bear it | Sorrows of sadness | It covers your pure face | And the roses in your cheeks | It's forbidden to drown him | May he be sacrificed for you | May a heart that is ready for whatever you desire be sacrificed for you | I sacrifice for you what remains of my precious possessions | What has passed | Let what's gone be gone | And don't worry about tomorrow | And seize from today what its fortunes have brought

poem_matla: خذ العفو
title: خذ العفو
translation_en: Take forgiveness and rise above people when they err | And whoever thinks ill of you, leave him to his suspicion | By God, those who think ill only harm themselves | He nurtures a claw in his chest and gets wounded by it | Don't let improving the thoughts of those who suspect occupy you | People don't hold the keys to heaven and hell | You shouldn't abandon your work to fix someone's bad opinion of you | Frankly, you don't have time for that | Whoever meets me will be blessed with happiness from those I have rights over - well done! | As for the rest, let them judge as they will - well done! | A famous person is naturally exposed to both good and bad, to gossip and talk | You go to see this one | A bad assumption about you, you go to fix it | You honestly don't have time | Whoever meets me will be blessed with happiness from those who owe me a right | And not the remaining people, whoever rules will rule | Well done, well done | The famous man, the human being in general, is exposed to both good and bad | Being exposed to gossip and rumors is natural

poem_matla: من ذُرى هيثم التاريخ شاهد عيان
title: من ذُرى هيثم
translation_en: From the peaks of Haitham, history is an eyewitness | From the peaks of Haitham, history is an eyewitness | In the peaks of Mohammed, history stands tall and ancient | May the family of Younis be in the gardens of paradise | A sad day's heart in the soul of a glorious day | Haitham's face embraced us before the explanation | And every house in Oman feels the loss | Long live my lord, may glory last, may peace endure | Consolation does not last in the state of Al Bu Said | Stop, there are still feet to stand and be inspired | He departed but remains, even if dark clouds asked his lights to disappear | On a night that rains departure and pens flow | For the loss of one whose presence was a dream's face, hard to repeat | The sunset of voice from the pulse of places extinguishes the days | The sunrise of longing in the Emirates' chest, its fire burns on every path | His steps embraced wedding and orphans' mourning | To the sick he comes from travel to visit | The hands of wind carried him in the procession of flags | And people's hands sometimes embrace him and sometimes protect him | As if Al Ain wasn't a country, it was from the wombs | How much he lived as Al Ain's eye, dedicating his life to his home | Because the palms of Hili spread about him tales of generosity | A date bunch from Mazyad hangs over Buraimi as good tidings | He departed, yet remains, even if the dark clouds asked permission for its lights to disappear | On a night that rains departure and the pens flowed | For the loss of one whose presence was a dream's face, difficult to repeat | The voice's sunset from the pulse of places extinguishes the days | The sunrise of longing in the chest of the emirate ignites its fire on every path | His step embraces both wedding and orphans' mourning | Upon the sick who are visited by those coming from travel | The visiting hands of the wind were carrying him in the procession of flags | And people's hands sometimes embrace him and sometimes fortify him | The hands of the wind were carrying him in the procession of flags | And people's hands sometimes embrace him and sometimes fortify him | As if the eye was not a country, it was from the wombs | As long as the apple of the eye lived, he spent his life for his home | Because the palm trees of my beloved spread tales of generosity about him | A date cluster descended from Mazeed upon Al Buraimi as good tidings | As if the eye was never a homeland | She was from the wombs/kinship | As long as the apple of the eye lived his lifetime in his home | Because the palm trees of my beloved spread tales of generosity about him | A date cluster hangs from Mazeed over Al Buraimi | A herald's sketch for a harbinger | And the breezes were formed from his kindness | And the Shuwaib farm was colored by the oasis of his thoughts | You have no burden/It's not too much for you | Inspiration rose high in the elegy for Tahnoun bin Mohammed | Ink of history from the soul of heritage breathes its stories | Inspiration rose high in the elegy for Tahnoun bin Mohammed | Ink of history from the soul of heritage breathes its stories | Poetry and heritage mourned him, and camels bearing numbers for it | And a falcon from the sky trained to circle searching for one named Sarah | Poetry and heritage mourned him, and camels bearing numbers for it | And a falcon from the sky trained to circle searching for one named Sarah | A civilization that shaped his character | And authenticity has aged/refined the attire | The identity of a land even between seconds | And the first button | The support of Zayed | The support of Zayed, before the desert becomes fragrant with clover and lavender | Self-made | One day alone, seven abundant paradises | Her belt | The day Khalifa became her age and dreams ascended | His sword | When Muhammad placed her chest above the probe/measure | The support of Zayed | The support of Zayed, before the desert becomes fragrant with clover and lavender | Self-made | One day alone, seven abundant paradises | Her belt | The day Khalifa became her age and dreams ascended | His sword | When Muhammad placed her chest above the probe/measure | A journey of righteousness | He wrapped himself in the ihram at eighty years of age | From sincerity/devotion | And in the two-year journey with determination | Stand, let us be proud | We stand to be proud and not to weep | Clouds whose thunder is ahead | And rain remains in the city's memory as ten rivers | Thank you | Your safety/wellbeing | You don't need to worry too much | May God brighten your faces | May God brighten your faces

text:

مع الخيال ألقاك كني لقيتك

يقولون العرب كل الأيام
يوم عليك ويوم لا جاك
جيتك ويا قلب
